title: A deleted customer reads Deleted customer in a tier's Audit Log
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit' and 'View and Manage AP/AR Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with no work orders, Part Sales, vehicles, contacts, transactions, payments or credit, put on tier A for work orders through Manage Customers.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's page from Customers.
  2. Delete customer A from its page.
  3. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  4. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  5. Open the page's three-dot menu.
  6. Click Audit Log.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer A's page opens.

Step 2:

  • Customer A is deleted.

Step 3:

  • The Tiers list shows tier A.

Step 4:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 5:

  • The menu lists Audit Log.

Step 6:

  • The customer event for customer A names them "Deleted customer".
  • The "Tier Created" entry is still listed.
